# `neuroedge_marketing` — module context

> **Scope rule.** When you are working in `neuroedge_marketing`, treat this module as your
> working set. Do **not** open other modules' internals to understand them —
> use their **public surface** (below / documented in the root `CLAUDE.md`).
> If you genuinely need a fact from another module, **delegate to an `Explore`
> subagent** so its files don't fill this context window.

**Purpose:** Marketing video pipeline, run offline and gated by human approval: `validate` → `approve --stage script` → `fetch` →
`approve --stage footage` → `render`. Guide: `docs/guides/how_to_create_marketing_video.md` (ADR-0016).

**Public surface (safe for other modules to depend on):** `cli.cmd_fetch`, `assembler.assemble`, `assembler.ensure_ffmpeg`,
`assembler.resolve_ffmpeg`, `providers.get_provider`, `schema.Storyboard`, `schema.FootageManifest` — the NeuroEdge Studio
imports these, so keep their signatures backward compatible.

**Entry points:** `cli.py` (`python -m neuroedge_marketing.cli`) &nbsp;•&nbsp; **Sub-packages:** — &nbsp;•&nbsp; **Tests:** `tests/test_marketing_*.py`

**Top-level files** (fill the second column with a one-line role):

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `approval.py` | SHA-256 approval stamps for script and footage; `render`/`fetch` refuse without them |
| `assembler.py` | ffmpeg assembly: clips, voice mix, captions, title cards, 16:9 and 1:1 cuts |
| `captions.py` | `.ass` captions: from the approved script (default) or faster-whisper transcription |
| `cli.py` | Subcommands, gate checks, per-scene voice orchestration |
| `contact_sheet.py` | Static HTML contact sheet of chosen and alternate clips for footage review |
| `providers.py` | Pexels/Pixabay search, cache, ranking; optional vision scoring (Anthropic/OpenAI) |
| `schema.py` | Pydantic models: `Storyboard`, scenes, brand, CTA, `FootageManifest` |
| `tts.py` | Voice providers: OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Chatterbox (local) |
| `voice.py` | Per-scene voice-over, measurement, storyboard re-timing, `say_as` substitution |
